title: astragalus parnassi subsp. cylleneus
intro: Astragalus parnassi subsp. cylleneus, commonly known as Cylene milkvetch, is a species of flowering plant in the legume family. It is used in traditional medicine and is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving immune function, and lowering blood sugar levels. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, that have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. Research suggests that Astragalus parnassi subsp. cylleneus may have potential applications in the treatment of various diseases, including diabetes, cardiovascular disease, and cancer.
